data.name: Achievements_SecretDescription
data.value: Secret achievement. Its condition will be revealed after you unlock it.

data.name: Winner_Description
data.value: Finish a game in first place. A tie for first also counts.

data.name: Streak_Description
data.value: Give 5 correct answers in a row in one game.

data.name: BigGame_Description
data.value: Finish a game with 15,000 points or more.

data.name: Score30K_Description
data.value: Finish a game with 30,000 points or more.

data.name: TotalScore100K_Description
data.value: Accumulate at least 100,000 points across all completed games.

data.name: TotalScore500K_Description
data.value: Accumulate at least 500,000 points across all completed games.

data.name: TotalScore1M_Description
data.value: Accumulate at least 1,000,000 points across all completed games.

data.name: Flawless_Description
data.value: Give at least 10 answers in one game without a single mistake.

data.name: FromAbyss_Description
data.value: Drop below zero points and still finish that same game with a positive score.

data.name: OwnQuizWithOthers_Description
data.value: Create your own quiz and play it with at least two other players.

data.name: PublicQuizGuest_Description
data.value: Play a public quiz hosted by someone other than its author.

data.name: SoloAi_Description
data.value: Play “Guess What I Play?” against AI.

data.name: RoomCreatorWin_Description
data.value: Create a “Guess What I Play?” room, play another player, and win.

data.name: GitHubVisitor_Description
data.value: Visit the Bad Wolf Quiz repository on GitHub through a site link.

data.name: QuizRated_Description
data.value: Rate a quiz after the final question.

data.name: AllInCorrect_Description
data.value: Make an All In wager and answer correctly.

data.name: AllInWrong_Description
data.value: Make an All In wager and answer incorrectly.

data.name: DeveloperReplied_Description
data.value: Write to the developer and receive a reply.

data.name: Contributor_Description
data.value: Become a Bad Wolf Quiz contributor.

data.name: FirstPick_Description
data.value: Be the first player to choose a question in a game.

data.name: SecondRoundFirstPick_Description
data.value: Be the first player to choose a question in the second round.

data.name: LastRoundComebackWin_Description
data.value: Have the lowest score when the last regular round starts, choose its first question, and finish the game in first place.

data.name: FinalLeaderZero_Description
data.value: Lead when the final question begins and finish the game with exactly 0 points.

data.name: EveryCategoryAttempt_Description
data.value: Attempt at least one question in every category of a round with at least 5 categories.

data.name: EveryCategoryCorrect_Description
data.value: Answer at least one question correctly in every category of a round with at least 5 categories.

data.name: SilentRound_Description
data.value: Play an entire round without pressing the buzzer once.

data.name: SilentRoundGain_Description
data.value: Finish a round with more points than you started it with without pressing the buzzer once.
